## G. SAI NARAYANA RAO
ADVOCATE

Regd Post with Acknowledgement

LEGAL NOTICE

Date: 28 May 2026

To

To
The Editor-in-Chief
Sakshi Daily Newspaper
Kanoor, Vijayawada,
Andhra Pradesh.

Subject: Legal Notice for Publication of False, Defamatory and Misleading
News Reports against the Sports Authority of Andhra Pradesh (SAAP).

Sir/Madam,

Under instructions and on behalf of my client, the Sports Authority of Andhra
Pradesh (SAAP), a statutory authority functioning under the Government of Andhra
Pradesh, I hereby issue the present Legal Notice as follows:

My client informs me that your newspaper, Sakshi Daily, published false,
misleading, baseless and defamatory news items dated 24.04.2026,30.04.2026, and
26.05.2026 concerning the Sports DSC-2025 recruitment process, thereby causing
serious prejudice to the reputation and credibility of SAAP, creating unnecessary
panic and suspicion among candidates and misleading the public at large regarding
the fairness and transparency of the recruitment process undertaken by a Government
authority.

That SAAP issued Notification dated 01.05.2025 for recruitment of 421 Mega DSC
posts under the Sports Quota. Pursuant thereto, approximately 3600 candidates
applied with 5328 post preferences against the notified vacancies and the scrutiny and
verification of sports certificates and supporting documents have been undertaken
strictly in accordance with Government Orders, prescribed procedure and directions
issued by the Government of Andhra Pradesh.

addressed herein below:

## I. FALSE NEWS ITEM DATED 24.04.2026 - ALLEGATIONS REGARDING
ILLEGAL COLLECTION OF MONEY FOR SPORTS DSC POSTS

Your newspaper published allegations suggesting irregularities and corruption in
Sports DSC-2025 recruitments by referring to certain telephonic conversations
wherein unknown persons allegedly demanded money from candidates for securing
Sports Quota posts.

The said publication deliberately omitted the material fact that SAAP itself
proactively identified the fraudulent activity and immediately initiated legal and
preventive action in the interest of candidates and public transparency.

That during scrutiny of sports certificates relating to Sports Mega DSC-2025
recruitments, SAAP received a video/audio recording relating to suspicious
conversations between certain unknown individuals, including one person using
Mobile No.9440755843, wherein false assurances were allegedly made to candidates
regarding government postings in exchange for money and by falsely representing
themselves as persons capable of influencing Government recruitments.

The said acts created apprehension and confusion among Sports Quota candidates
and attempted to undermine public confidence in Government recruitments.

Immediately upon receiving such information, SAAP:

a) issued a public awareness video cautioning candidates and the public not to fall
prey to fake calls or fraudulent demands for money in the name of Sports DSC
recruitment;

b) released an official press note dated 12.08.2025 warning candidates against
fraudsters;

c) caused publication of the said awareness material and press note in newspapers and
media for wider public awareness; and
